lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular pixel clusters arranged in distinct vertical columns, with greater cluster density observed in the anterior-most visible region of the flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated luminance intersecting with the circular clusters to form a rectangular grid-like arrangement in the mid-lateral section.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Linear horizontal feature in the upper flank region exhibiting a sharp luminance gradient, with higher values on the dorsal side and lower values on the ventral side.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A curved linear mark with low pixel intensity is visible in the upper-left quadrant. A small indentation is visible on the trailing edge of the pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: A small yellow organism with vertical black stripes is present adjacent to the pectoral fin.
